about: The MCX) commenced operation in Nov,03 is India’s first listed, national-level, electronic exchange, and India’s leading commodity derivatives exchange which offers the benefits of fair price discovery and price risk management to the Indian commodity market ecosystem. The Exchange operates under SEBI. [1]
